actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 395 - 14 (Roll no. 33). (text: CR H931)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 395 - 14 (Roll no. 33). (text: CR H931)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H940)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 5764.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H931-932)
Mr. Williams (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 351.
Reported (Amended) by the Committee on Small Business. H. Rept. 119-403.
Reported (Amended) by the Committee on Small Business. H. Rept. 119-403.
Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 27 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Small Business.

dimensions.assessment: Affects small business concerns utilizing Small Business Development Centers for operational and compliance guidance.
dimensions.evidence: assisting small business concerns in evaluating artificial intelligence concerning operations

dimensions.assessment: Expands advisory services provided by development centers to include artificial intelligence best practices and resilience planning.
dimensions.evidence: providing information, guidance, and training to small business concerns on the use of artificial intelligence

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly prohibits any additional amounts from being authorized to carry out the act.
dimensions.evidence: No additional amounts are authorized to carry out this Act or the amendments made by this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Small Business Act to add specific counseling and outreach duties regarding artificial intelligence to existing centers.
dimensions.evidence: amending Section 21(c)(3) of the Small Business Act

dimensions.assessment: Amends permanent statutory duties for Small Business Development Centers.

missing_information: Specific estimates of the number of small businesses that will participate or receive training are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Small Business Act to mandate that Small Business Development Centers provide artificial intelligence guidance and training to small businesses, operating under a strict no-additional-funds rule.
